name: computing-grades
title: How the best report is found
idea: This browser searches small families report by report, dynamic programming cuts one declared order exactly, and postrank's solver takes the joint problem and reports its status, bound and gap.
from: new concept · v1 storyboard P-08; theory book ch. 14; postrank vignette m5 (enumeration, fixed-order DP, MIP with status, bound and gap); picture: family sizes on a log axis, the 0/1 patterns of three units, the dynamic-programming table filling cell by cell, and a HiGHS solve with its incumbent risk, bound, gap and status
credit: After the postrank vignette m5 and the theory book, ch. 14.
caption: Family counts and search results computed in this browser. Six fictional sites use the postrank tutorial score-A posterior; the joint solver uses a frozen simulated league. Optimization answers only for its stated family and supplied probabilities.
